subject: Scaling Multimodal Behavioural Intelligence at Retiro | Learnings from Synthesia & Twelve Labs
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I lead the Multimodal Behavioral Intelligence team at Encord (end-to-end platform focused on data curation, annotation & model evaluation, ~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding). Recently been working with Synthesia and Twelve Labs to provide them with the right tools & expertise to leverage high quality video & audio data in their model development. Teams were struggling to scale their data pipelines while simultaneously annotating multimodal data, slowing down model iterations - this was particularly painful as they onboarded new clients / projects. 

Given the direction [COMPANY] seems to be heading - keen to get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work best.

subject: Video-native annotation
text:
Hi [NAME], 

We recently released our case study: [LINK] with Standard AI, who we helped to save $600k/year by moving to Encord's video-native annotation platform. 

The key reason teams usually move over to Encord is to handle video-native annotation - many other commercial or in-house tools (e.g. Labelbox, V7, CVAT etc) struggle to consistently create labels that are aligned with corresponding frames due to difficulties rendering video in modern web browsers. 

If you'd like to dive deeper into this topic, you can read more about this in our blog post: [LINK] on video label synchronisation.

Let me know if you have any questions & will be happy to help,​

subject: Video-native annotation
text:
Hi [NAME], 

We recently released our case study: [LINK] with Standard AI, who we helped to save $600k/year by moving to Encord's video-native annotation platform. 

The key reason teams usually move over to Encord is to handle video-native annotation - many other commercial or in-house tools (e.g. Labelbox, V7, CVAT etc) struggle to consistently create labels that are aligned with corresponding frames due to difficulties rendering video in modern web browsers. 

If you'd like to dive deeper into this topic, you can read more about this in our blog post: [LINK] on synchronised video annotation.

Let me know if you have any questions & will be happy to help,​
